summary: odh-dashboard (also known as: ODH Dashboard) is a Kubernetes component. deploying 25 workload(s) (rhaii-dashboard, odh-dashboard, maas-portal, rhaii-dashboard, agent-ops-ui, automl-ui, autorag-ui, data-connect-hub-ui, data-registry-ui, eval-hub-ui, gen-ai-ui, maas-ui, mlflow-ui, model-registry-ui, notebooks-ui, workspaces-backend, workspaces-frontend, workspaces-backend, workspaces-controller, workspaces-controller, workspaces-controller, workspaces-controller, dashboard-operator, workspaces-controller, workspaces-controller) with 27 container(s). watching 7 resource type(s). exposing 19 service(s) on ports: 4000, 443, 8043, 8080, 8143, 8243, 8343, 8443, 8543, 8643, 8743, 8843, 8943, 9043, 9143, 9243. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports: 4000, 8080, 8443. with 1 webhook(s) (1 validating). protected by 24 network policy/policies. with 2 PodDisruptionBudget(s). connecting to external services: postgres, s3. runtime dependencies: MLflow, MySQL, OpenTelemetry Collector, PostgreSQL, S3, dch-default-dataconnectservice-flight, dynatrace-mcp-server, image-registry, kubernetes, kubernetes-mcp-server, llama-32-3b-instruct-predictor, maas-api, mlflow, mock-evalhub, mock-predictor, s, sample-support-agent. with 2458 operator config constants (37 image references, 1 env vars). with 6 ingress route(s). integrates with Istio, KServe, Kueue, Prometheus, management relationship via labels/annotations. deploys kube-rbac-proxy sidecar for RBAC-based authorization. creates RBAC bindings to external roles: system:auth-delegator, system:image-puller. references components: eval-hub (client, import), kserve (import, provider), kubeflow (import), llama-stack (client, config, import), mlflow (import), model-registry (client, config, import), trustyai-service-operator (import). mounts 4 ConfigMap(s) as volumes: autorag-router-ca-bundle, kube-rbac-proxy-config, maas-portal-federation-config, odh-trusted-ca-bundle.
